name: Uchuu no Kujira
source:
The Galaxy Express's destination is _______

You've found yourself lost on the Galaxy Express traveling through space.
All you have in your hand is a "ticket with no destination."

A Galaxy Express novel game where you engage in conversations with passengers on board and begin to understand where the train is headed.
